pages.text: These glyphs are tools to provide the stack with pre-set information, providing a source for many of the most fundamental species for many spells.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.push_int
pages.text: → $(n)number$()$(br)Pushes a given number onto the capsum. Practitioners may select the glyph by ‘shift-clicking’, allowing them to ‘hover and scroll’ in order to change the glyph’s value. Pressing ‘shift’ while scrolling modifies the number by 10. The value of this glyph may not be greater than 99.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.true
pages.text: → $(n)boolean$()$(br)Pushes a boolean with value true onto the capsum.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.false
pages.text: → $(n)boolean$()$(br)Pushes a boolean with value false onto the capsum.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.rand_int
pages.text: $(n)num$() → $(n)num$()$(br)Pushes onto the capsum a random integer between zero and a popped number.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.rand_double
pages.text: → $(n)number$()$(br)Pushes a random decimal with a value between 0 and 1 onto the capsum.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.unit_x
pages.text: → $(n)vector$()$(br)Pushes a unit vector in the x direction onto the capsum (1, 0, 0).

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.unit_y
pages.text: → $(n)vector$()$(br)Pushes a unit vector in the y direction onto the capsum (0, 1, 0).

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.unit_z
pages.text: → $(n)vector$()$(br)Pushes a unit vector in the z direction onto the capsum (0, 0, 1).

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.push_pi
pages.text: → $(n)number$()$(br)Pushes a number with value pi onto the capsum.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.push_e
pages.text: → $(n)number$()$(br)Pushes a number with the value of Euler’s number onto the capsum.
